notes.note_text: The post implies Sydney Sweeney responded to Angel Reese's beauty comment, but this interaction is fabricated. Fact-checkers confirm Angel Reese never publicly commented on Sydney Sweeney, and viral content about exchanges between them is fake/digitally edited. https://www.marca.com/en/basketball/wnba/chicago-sky/2025/09/03/68b79d0122601d14778b45a7.html

False. The post claims shooter is "David Cohen" who is "JEWISH, FROM ISRAEL." Authorities identify suspects as 50-year-old Australian father & son Naveed Akram, Pakistani national. No credible evidence of any Israeli suspect named David Cohen. https://www.cbsnews.com/news/australia-bondi-beach-suspects-father-and-son/

This post contains a fabricated death hoax. Rob Reiner and his wife are alive, and Trump did not make this statement. The "death" story is a complete fabrication with no police reports or credible news sources. https://inews.zoombangla.com/rob-reiner-death-hoax-viral-false-report-debunked-by-director-himself/

This claim that Scott Cawthon has died is false. Multiple sources confirm this is an unfounded rumor with no credible evidence. Scott Cawthon is alive, and no official statements or credible news outlets have reported his death. https://www.timesnownews.com/world/us/us-buzz/is-scott-cawthon-alive-rumours-surface-about-five-nights-at-freddys-creators-death-article-118768688
